Freeze the event and windows before joint-outcome access. Shock day D qualifies only when abs(close[D,23:00] / close[D-1,23:00] - 1) is at least Decimal 0.0300. Design is [2019-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z); Validation is [2023-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z). The 20 baseline days, D and D+1 must all be complete and wholly inside the same window. Validation is historical validation, never clean OOS.

Freeze the joint formulas before outcome access. Shock sign is +1 for UP and -1 for DOWN. SignedResponseH24(D) equals shock sign times (close[D+1,23:00] / close[D,23:00] - 1). Hourly simple return includes each UTC day's first hour against the preceding day's 23:00 close. RV24(day) is the Decimal sum of the 24 squared hourly simple returns. BaselineRV20(D) is the ordinary median of RV24 for exactly D-20 through D-1. OutcomeRatio(D) equals RV24(D+1) / BaselineRV20(D). An elevated-volatility episode has OutcomeRatio strictly greater than 1. Use Decimal precision at least 50 and no alternate return, variance, horizon, lookback or threshold.

Frozen positive rule: retain only when the elevated-volatility subset has at least 100 Design and 40 Validation episodes, with at least 40 UP and 40 DOWN in Design and 15 UP and 15 DOWN in Validation; at least 36 Design and 18 Validation target UTC months; maximum single-month share at most 0.10 and maximum single absolute SignedResponseH24 contribution share at most 0.50 in each window; overall, UP-conditioned and DOWN-conditioned median SignedResponseH24 all strictly below zero in both windows; reversal share strictly above 0.50 overall and for UP and DOWN in both windows; and annual overall median SignedResponseH24 below zero in at least three of four Design years and both Validation years. Any valid gate failure closes the joint prior; no neighboring or rescue variant is allowed.

OutcomeRatio and SignedResponseH24 both use D+1 information and are unavailable at D+1 00:00. Therefore a retained result is only a historical joint risk prior and cannot be treated as a tradable condition or predictor. It may constrain later sizing and path-risk design only after the separately frozen directional and volatility forward diagnostics both terminate positively and one later equal-capital strategy specification is authorized.
